value.rationale: The source motivates whether a bounded stochastic population has a persistently vacant-state mode and an occupied-state mode, but focuses chiefly on active-period durations. This theorem gives the exact finite-size two-parameter population-count phase boundary and its discrete-lattice correction, clarifying when immigration removes the vacant peak and when increased contact birth creates an occupied peak. The 1/sqrt(N) transition is a natural sharp finite-capacity effect absent from deterministic logistic threshold classification; the fact is not a mere restatement of a product stationary formula.
